basis: Consolidated · Power Finance Corporation and controlled companies, including REC
coverage: Whole group · one reported lending segment
incomeDefinition: Total income includes interest, dividends, fees and other reported income. The amount a borrower returns on the original loan is not income. This total comes before the group pays borrowing costs and other expenses.
definition: Whole group earnings after expenses and tax, including the share belonging to outside shareholders in controlled companies.
sourceLabel: Audited consolidated annual results filed on 13 May 2026
location: PDF pages 22–23 · consolidated results and owners’ shares; pages 27–28 · notes 5, 7, 8 and 11
notes: Interest income was ₹112,961.44 crore and funding costs were ₹69,415.32 crore. Changes in expected losses on financial items produced a net credit of ₹1,584.93 crore, which reduced reported expenses; this is not a measure of cash collected. Profit includes a separate ₹18.28 crore charge for a claim tied to a historic project-company transfer handled by a company controlled by REC Limited. Group profit includes ₹7,724.39 crore for outside shareholders; ₹25,900.95 crore belongs to the parent’s owners.
insight: Most group income is interest, and raising money to lend is its biggest expense. The year’s reduction in the expected-loss expense boosted reported profit. The totals do not identify the profit from lending to any particular project or technology.
